get.summary: Read Dew balance and prepaid storage allowance
get.description: Requires the account bearer. Returns account_id, asset_id, enabled, used_bytes, free_bytes (10485760), units_per_dew (1000000), plans [{size,limit_bytes,monthly_units,yearly_units,monthly_xmr_atomic_units,yearly_xmr_atomic_units}] for size 1gb (1073741824 bytes; 2 Dew a month, 20 Dew a year) and 5gb (5368709120 bytes; 6 Dew a month, 60 Dew a year), and plan {period,size,expires_at,limit_bytes,balance}. The top-level monthly_units, yearly_units, monthly_xmr_atomic_units and yearly_xmr_atomic_units repeat the 1gb plan for older apps. Balance and prices are integer millionths of Dew. XMR prices use integer atomic units (1 XMR = 1000000000000 atomic units), derived from the fixed node funding ratio, rounded up to fund the complete purchase. No fiat prices or external exchange-rate feed are used. Missing or unrepresentable XMR prices disable upgrades. The enabled node grants free_bytes free, or the plan size until expires_at. Expiry blocks growth while preserving reads and deletions.

200.description: Account-scoped Dew balance and storage allowance; no-store

post.summary: Buy one month or one year of 1 GB or 5 GB storage with Dew
post.description: Explicit prepaid purchase of a plan from GET: 1gb costs 2 Dew a month or 20 Dew a year, 5gb costs 6 Dew a month or 60 Dew a year. A missing size means 1gb. Display the plan's Dew price returned by GET before purchase. A configured fixed XMR funding ratio is required. The same size extends unexpired time or starts now; another size starts now with the unexpired time converted at the monthly price ratio (remaining x old / new, rounded down). Does not auto-renew. The debit and allowance commit atomically. Preserve request_id on uncertain results: repeating it never charges or extends twice; changing the period or size for the same ID is rejected. Monero funding uses the existing account subaddress and confirmed deposit reconciliation.

400.description: Invalid period, size or request ID

409.description: Request ID reused for another period or size

503.description: Upgrades disabled or unavailable; retain the request ID
